correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact 81-state W/Y/B color automaton is a complete local rephrasing of PEDS: an omitted edge requires endpoint selected degrees summing to one; selected edges can meet. The reachable/co-reachable intersection has the isolated BB loop plus a directed six-cycle with four permitted boundary phases, yielding z^{3n-2}+4z^n for n≡2 mod 3 and z^{3n-2}+2z^n otherwise. Six-step cyclic weight increment gives n for proper sets. Independently enumerated every edge subset for n=2..7, recovering (4,2,2,4,2,2) proper sets of size n plus the full edge set; the finite-state argument (not small n) supplies the all-n extension. The no-DIM conclusion follows because every nontrivial pattern has incident selected edges. The generated open-ladder source checker was read, not relied on as a standalone proof.
